docs.text: I’d like to dedicate this 30 minute walk (in -3F/-18C windchill) to my childhood trips gulling on Lake Erie in January, for which I own a shin-length parka

Okay, I’ve brushed and scraped all the cars on my side of the street and shoveled the block. Time to go into the office just to show that I know how to drive and loudly state that “this is nothin’” and talk about Lake Erie winters to everyone within earshot.
an iced fruit tea so refreshing u feel like you’re sitting in a shaded beachside cafe by lake michigan on a hot June day in 1948
Yeah it was hot today, but every bike slot on the MKE-CHI Hiawatha was booked. Yay Amtrak, yay bikes! 🤝 PS: dunking your jersey in the lake is free 🆒😎
*me standing next to Lake Superior being interviewed about how scary it is* I don't like being cold and I don't even like rollercoasters
Another amazing day here on the shores of Lake Erie. Rode from High Meadows to Lake Erie and back in almost 60 degree weather. Covered 19 miles and just over 600 feet of elevation gain. #gravelbike

I'm sitting here freezing my tail off in a cold Great Lakes evening, and remembering that I wrote the NIGHT CALLS books during the full moon, through months of Texas heat. But lots of the stories were winter stories. :) #fantasy #comingofage #NeurodivergentHero bookviewcafe.com/bvc_author/k...

Ahhhh! At the beach! Sunset Bay Irving, NY. Beautiful Lake Erie! Hot! But beautiful breeze from lake and water still just cool enough.
#NYState #LakeErie
I had to chip ice off my car to go to work. I had to chip off ice to drive home from work. Lake Erie CALM THE FUCK DOWN!
It was a chilly, but gorgeous, afternoon to walk our local beach on Lake Erie.
The train out of here is a shit show. So I’m walking. At least I got a stiff Lake Erie wind at my back
Hitch a ride. I’m a one minute walk from Lake Erie. We get cool breezes all summer long!
I'm pooped too. Have a warm day. It is 10 below here on Lake Erie.

I walked to a very cold lake Michigan today and the undulating of the pancake ice topper on the frigid water was so soothing and hypnotic. That is the kind of white noise video that'd be great for falling asleep

Drinks I’ll remember for life, in no particular order: 1. Cup of coffee my dad made for me one morning in 1998. I was home for winter break and just stayed up to watch the sunrise over a frozen Lake Michigan. It was not fancy, just old school drip. Platonic ideal of American coffee.
I managed to get a good walk in this afternoon. All the ice is gone on Lake Erie!

It was really difficult NOT to be awestruck by Bear Point (Mukwa Nayoshing) 🐻 Walking and Scrambling in the Canadian Shield and swimming in a perfect temperature Lake Huron. And made it happen while we napped to and from! 🥾🥽🚌
